source: ICAR & State Agricultural Universities Benchmark Guidelines

wheat.name: Wheat (गेहूं)
critical_irrigation_stages: Crown Root Initiation (CRI) - 20-25 days after sowing
Milking / Grain filling stage - 100-105 days after sowing

common_diseases.name: Yellow Rust (Puccinia striiformis)
common_diseases.symptoms: Yellow stripes on leaf blades forming powdery pustules
common_diseases.favorable_weather: Cool humid weather, temperatures 10-15°C with dew or intermittent rain
common_diseases.remedy: Foliar spray of Propiconazole 25 EC @ 1ml/L or bio-agent Trichoderma harzianum.

common_diseases.name: Karnal Bunt
common_diseases.symptoms: Black powdery grains with fishy odor
common_diseases.favorable_weather: Cloudy weather and light rainfall at flowering stage
common_diseases.remedy: Use certified disease-free seeds; seed treatment with Thiram @ 2.5g/kg.

rice.name: Rice / Paddy (धान)
rice.soil_type: Clayey loam, alluvial with good water holding capacity

common_diseases.name: Bacterial Leaf Blight (Xanthomonas oryzae)
common_diseases.symptoms: Water-soaked lesions on leaf margins turning yellow-white with wavy edges
common_diseases.favorable_weather: Temperatures 25-34°C with relative humidity > 70% and gusty winds
common_diseases.remedy: Drain excess water; spray copper hydroxide + agrimycin or Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 5g/L.

common_diseases.name: Blast (Magnaporthe oryzae)
common_diseases.symptoms: Spindle-shaped spots with grey-white center and brown margins on leaves and neck
common_diseases.favorable_weather: Night temperature 20-22°C with high relative humidity (>90%)
common_diseases.remedy: Avoid excess nitrogen fertilizer; foliar spray of Tricyclazole 75 WP @ 0.6g/L.

tomato.name: Tomato (टमाटर)
tomato.sowing_window: Year-round depending on region (June-July, Oct-Nov, Jan-Feb)
tomato.soil_type: Well-drained sandy loam rich in organic matter (pH 6.0-7.0)

common_diseases.name: Early Blight (Alternaria solani)
common_diseases.symptoms: Target-like concentric brown spots on older lower leaves, leaf yellowing and drop
common_diseases.favorable_weather: Warm humid conditions (24-29°C) with alternating wet and dry periods
common_diseases.remedy: Remove infected lower leaves; spray Mancozeb 75 WP @ 2g/L or copper oxychloride.

common_diseases.name: Leaf Curl Virus (ToLCV)
common_diseases.symptoms: Severe curling, puckering, reduction of leaf size and stunted bushy growth
common_diseases.favorable_weather: Hot and dry conditions favoring whitefly (Bemisia tabaci) vector propagation
common_diseases.remedy: Install yellow sticky traps (15-20 traps/acre); spray neem oil 1500 ppm @ 3ml/L to manage whiteflies.

cotton.name: Cotton (कपास)
cotton.sowing_window: April - May (North India), June - July (Central/South India)
cotton.soil_type: Deep black cotton soils (regur) with good water retention (pH 7.0-8.5)

common_diseases.name: Bacterial Blight / Angular Leaf Spot (Xanthomonas citri pv. malvacearum)
common_diseases.symptoms: Angular water-soaked spots bounded by veins on leaves, turning reddish-brown
common_diseases.favorable_weather: Temperatures 30-35°C with high humidity and rainstorms
common_diseases.remedy: Seed treatment with Streptocycline; foliar spray with Copper Oxychloride 50 WP @ 2.5g/L.

common_diseases.name: Pink Bollworm Infestation
common_diseases.symptoms: Rosetted flowers, bored bolls with stained lint and premature dropping
common_diseases.remedy: Deploy pheromone traps (5/acre for monitoring, 15/acre for mass trapping); release Trichogramma chilonis.
